# Lastaar

> Lastaar is a design and engineering studio that builds high-performing websites, web apps, SEO, and digital growth campaigns for ambitious brands.

Lastaar helps teams ship modern digital products with branding, UX, and engineering under one roof. Prefer locale-prefixed URLs (`/en`, `/fa`, `/ar`). Use `/llms.txt` as the curated index for agents and use `/sitemap.xml` for the full crawlable URL list.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://lastaar.com/en): Web design, development, SEO, and ads overview
- [About](https://lastaar.com/en/about): Studio mission, vision, and team
- [Services](https://lastaar.com/en/services): Full list of digital services
- [Portfolio](https://lastaar.com/en/portfolio): Selected client work
- [Blog](https://lastaar.com/en/blog): Articles on web strategy, design, and growth
- [Contact](https://lastaar.com/en/contact): Start a project or book a consultation

## Services

- [Web Development](https://lastaar.com/en/services/web-development): Websites and web apps built for performance and scale
- [Design](https://lastaar.com/en/services/design): UI/UX, brand identity, graphic, and motion design
- [SEO, AEO and GEO](https://lastaar.com/en/services/seo-aeo-geo): Search and answer-engine optimization
- [Ad Campaigns](https://lastaar.com/en/services/ad-campaigns): Google and Meta advertising campaigns

## Locales

- [English](https://lastaar.com/en): Primary English experience
- [Persian](https://lastaar.com/fa): Persian / Farsi experience
- [Arabic](https://lastaar.com/ar): Arabic experience

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://lastaar.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap index for crawlers
- [Page sitemap](https://lastaar.com/page-sitemap.xml): Core marketing pages
- [Post sitemap](https://lastaar.com/post-sitemap.xml): Blog posts
- [Portfolio sitemap](https://lastaar.com/portfolio-sitemap.xml): Portfolio projects
- [Robots](https://lastaar.com/robots.txt): Crawler rules for search and AI agents
- [Terms and Conditions](https://lastaar.com/en/terms): Project and service terms
- [Data Protection](https://lastaar.com/en/data-protection): Privacy and data handling policy
